s: Based on a broad online survey of physicians to validate current prevalence estimates and additional research using artificial intelligence, which interrogated a database of more than 300 million anonymized patient records that spanned 10 years of insurance claims, we estimate there are between 1,800 and 3,700 WHIM patients in the United States, many of whom were previously undiagnosed.
